lede_html: EPC notices rose to 116 from 98 this week and tenders edged up to 34, while awards slipped to 49. One filer dominated the awards: China National Chemical Engineering (CNCEC) disclosed five contracts in a single filing, from a 300MW solar plant in Ghana to an FGL expansion in Algeria. The largest award was the US$403m Mechanical, Electrical and DSEAR Services contract in the UK. For bidders, the open work is in mid-sized European tenders, most of them closing in November, while CNCEC now has work committed on five jobs in three countries.

deals_why.Fuel distribution concession in Milan: Aci Informatica is offering a US$67m fuel distribution concession in Milan, and bids close on 9 Nov, which leaves little time to form a consortium.
deals_why.Catenary construction for electrificatio: ADIF is buying US$58m of catenary for the Zaragoza–Teruel–Sagunto electrification, and overhead-line suppliers and rail electrification contractors have until 27 Nov.
deals_why.Construction of district heating and coo: Södertörns Fjärrvärme is buying US$45m of district heating and cooling pipeline works for 2027, and pipe suppliers and civils contractors have until 30 Nov.
deals_why.Natural gas supply development in Botoșa: Transgaz is tendering US$35m of gas supply development in Botoșani across four lots, and its 6 Nov deadline is the earliest among this week's listed tenders.
deals_why.Construction of new 132/20 kV GIS substa: Valencia's port authority is tendering a US$23m 132/20 kV GIS substation with two transformers, and switchgear and transformer makers should price by 25 Nov.
deals_why.Mechanical, Electrical and DSEAR Service: Amentum and Galliford Try are now booked on the week's largest award at US$403m, so subcontractors should take mechanical, electrical and DSEAR packages to them.
deals_why.BASE ENERGY GHANA LIMITED 300MW solar EP: CNCEC is now booked on Base Energy Ghana's 300MW solar EPC at about US$385.9m, which works out at roughly US$1.29m per MW for suppliers pricing against it.
deals_why.FGL expansion project in Algeria: CNCEC took this US$241.1m EPCC contract from China Tianchen Engineering, so procurement for the Algerian FGL expansion now runs through Chinese contractors.
deals_why.Zhangzhou Longhai marine comprehensive u: Lanjinghai Potassium Technology (Fujian) has awarded CNCEC a US$164.6m EPC for the Longhai marine utilisation project, which takes up more of the contractor's capacity.
deals_why.Chongqing Zhaosheng natural gas liquefac: CNCEC's US$137.6m contract here is procurement and construction only, so equipment for this liquefaction phase will be bought through CNCEC.
deals_why.Railway maintenance works for rail grind: Salcef and G.C.F. are now booked on US$137m of rail grinding and profiling maintenance in Italy, which ties up both firms' track capacity.
deals_why.EDF SEI - ILE DE LA REUNION - HTA/BT net: EDF is buying US$123m of HTA/BT network work on Ile de la Réunion, and no deadline is given, so distribution equipment suppliers should check the notice directly.
